I am a **Statistics graduate** from the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) specializing in data science, statistical modeling, and computational methods.

My work bridges the gap between theoretical mathematical frameworks and practical, high-performance software tools.

## Core Specializations & Project Highlights

```{=html}
<div class="card">
```
*   **Statistical Software Engineering** — Developed custom R-packages from scratch for complex workflows like Multidimensional Scaling (MDS).
*   **Privacy & Machine Learning** — Evaluated synthetic data generation pipelines using Classification and Regression Trees (CART) on major panel data.
*   **E-Commerce A/B-Testing** — Conducted massive-scale web traffic analysis using both Frequentist and Bayesian estimation methods.
